story.title: Tailscale Traces Database Corruption to 16y/o SQLite WAL-Reset Bug

draft:
I just learned about a 16-year-old SQLite bug that's been causing database corruption. 
Tailscale recently traced their issues to this WAL-reset bug. 
The fact that it went undetected for so long is alarming. 
What other old bugs are hiding in our codebases? 
#SQLite #databasecorruption #softwarebugs
